source: Binance official monthly spot klines; August 2021 quote-volume selected static cohort

selection.criterion: top 30 USDT spot crypto base assets by 2021-08 sum quote-asset volume; exclude fiat/stable/leveraged bases

method.delisting_sensitivity: reported at -99.9% terminal loss and 0% additional loss after first unexplained gap; neither is a verified recovery return
method.short_financing: excluded as in frozen original; signed Binance research only
